high_level_description: This image depicts a serene beach scene during what appears to be early morning or late afternoon, given the soft lighting and the pale blue hue of the sky. The beach is expansive and mostly empty, with only a few scattered footprints visible in the sand. The sand itself is light-colored, possibly indicating fine grains. The ocean is calm with gentle waves lapping at the shore. In the distance, there is a line of buildings that seem to be part of a coastal town or village. These structures are small and blend into the horizon, suggesting they are not densely populated.
